simple.meaning: נֹעַר (nôʻar) is a Hebrew word meaning “(abstractly) boyhood.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H5290. noar נֹ֫עַר noun masculine youth, early life (rare poetic synonym for נְעוּרִים ); — absolute ׳נ Job 33:25 (= youthful vigour), 36:14 , ׳מִנּ Prov 29:21 ; Psa 88:16 from youth up .

occurrences.englishText: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s.
